title: Power consumption on the Google Pixel 9 Pro
creator: donbads1325
content: There is an issue with power consumption. All restrictions on background activity have been removed. Over 10 hours of idle time at night, the battery drains by about 15%, and according to the power consumption settings, this accounts for 80% of the total battery usage.
